jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.why: Strong Riyadh fit in GenAI/agents, though presales/enterprise consulting experience is lighter.

jd.text:
OmniOps is a Riyadh-based technology solutions provider, serving organizations across Saudi Arabia and beyond. With offices in Jordan, Egypt, and Morocco, we specialize in empowering businesses to migrate and scale their AI technology infrastructure confidently, achieving a high level of maturity in their digital landscapes. Our comprehensive services and products guarantee seamless cloud migration, scalability, and management, ensuring optimal performance and consistent reliability for our valued partners.

Role Description

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Solution Engineer to join our Riyadh team. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering with customers to design innovative AI-driven solutions that address complex business challenges. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and executive stakeholders to lead technical engagements, shape solution strategies, and position OmniOps as a strategic AI transformation partner.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent customer-facing, consulting, and presentation skills, and has hands-on experience designing enterprise AI, cloud, and data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with Sales and Business teams to understand customer objectives, business challenges, and technical requirements throughout the sales lifecycle.
• Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and architecture discussions to identify customer needs and define solution success criteria.
• Design scalable, secure, and cloud-native AI solution architectures tailored to customer environments.
• Translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions leveraging Generative AI, Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent agents, MLOps, data platforms, and cloud technologies.
• Deliver executive presentations, technical demonstrations, architecture reviews, and Proof of Concept (PoC) engagements.
• Prepare and lead technical responses for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, solution architectures, and technical documentation.
• Collaborate with Product Management, Data, and Engineering teams to ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and product capabilities.
• Lead customer workshops focused on AI strategy, enterprise architecture, data governance, intelligent automation, and digital transformation.
• Ensure a seamless transition from presales to delivery by validating solution architecture, implementation approach, technical scope, assumptions, and risks.
• Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies, cloud platforms, and industry trends to continuously strengthen OmniOps' solution portfolio.
• Mentor junior Solution Engineers and technical team members through coaching, technical reviews, and knowledge sharing.
• Represent OmniOps during executive customer meetings, partner engagements, conferences, and technical events.
• Contribute to presales methodologies, reusable solution assets, best practices, and technical playbooks.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• A Master's degree is considered an advantage.
• 5+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Presales, Solutions Architecture, Cloud Consulting, or Enterprise Software.
• Proven experience leading enterprise customer engagements from technical discovery through solution design and successful technical closure.
• Experience working with enterprise customers across cloud, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
• Strong knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, MLOps, and enterprise AI architectures.
• Hands-on experience developing or supporting Generative AI and Agentic AI applications.
• Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native architectures and integration patterns.
• Solid understanding of APIs, enterprise integration, networking, identity and access management, security, containers, and modern data platforms.
• Experience designing enterprise-scale cloud and AI architectures.
• Experience delivering Proofs of Concept (PoCs), technical workshops, demonstrations, and executive presentations.

Skills & Competencies

• Excellent solution architecture and technical consulting skills.
• Strong customer engagement and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Consultative selling mindset with the ability to align technology solutions to business outcomes.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple customer engagements in a fast-paced environment.
• Leadership and mentoring experience with junior technical team members.
• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• AI, cloud, or enterprise architecture certifications (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, or equivalent).
• Experience working for AI, cloud, or enterprise software vendors, system integrators, or technology consulting firms.
• Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, responsible AI practices, and modern data architectures.
• Familiarity with digital transformation initiatives across enterprise and government sectors in the GCC.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.why: Strong tech stack alignment with React, Python, Supabase, and PostgreSQL, though slightly junior-leaning (2+ years).

jd.text:
Dammam, Saudi Arabia

Apply Now!

Job Role: Full Stack Developer - Remote

• Company: Perfect Vision — Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
• Department: Automation

Role Summary Perfect Vision is looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our growing Automation Department. We are looking for someone with strong engineering skills who can work confidently across the backend, frontend, and database layers. A key focus of this role will be designing and building structured databases to replace existing Excel-based workflows and creating reliable systems that can support the company’s growing automation and technology needs.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across the full technology stack — from database architecture and APIs to frontend interfaces and system integrations — and be able to turn business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable relational databases for business applications and internal systems.
• Design database schemas, relationships, indexes, and data structures with scalability and performance in mind.
• Manage data migration from Excel and other unstructured sources into structured database systems.
• Optimize database queries and troubleshoot performance issues.
• Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and business logic.
• Build clean, responsive, and functional frontend applications and interfaces.
• Integrate databases and applications with CRM systems, automation platforms, and third-party APIs.
• Develop internal tools and applications to automate and improve business processes.
• Work with existing automation workflows and systems to ensure reliable data flow between different platforms.
• Maintain data integrity, security, and consistency across applications.
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
• Use Git and standard development practices for version control and collaboration.
• Work closely with the Automation team and different departments to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Troubleshoot, maintain, and continuously improve existing applications and systems.

Requirements

• Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar software engineering role.
• Strong experience with database design and management is essential.
• Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or MySQL, and modern databases such as Supabase.
• Good understanding of database architecture, data modeling, normalization, indexing, relationships, and query optimization.
• Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB is a plus.
• Strong backend development experience using technologies such as Node.js, Python/Django/Flask, or similar.
• Experience designing and developing REST APIs and web services.
• Strong frontend development experience with React, Vue, or similar frameworks.
• Experience connecting frontend, backend, databases, and third-party services into complete applications.
• Familiarity with Git and standard software development workflows.
• Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications

• At least 2 years of professional experience in Full Stack Development and/or Database Engineering.
• Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining production databases and database-driven applications.
• Strong hands-on experience with SQL, relational database design, data modeling, indexing, and query optimization.
• Experience developing both backend services/APIs and frontend applications.
• Experience with automation platforms such as n8n is a plus.
• Experience with Odoo, CRM, ERP, or other business management systems is a plus.
• Experience integrating APIs and third-party services is a plus.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.
• Experience building internal business applications, dashboards, or workflow management systems is a plus.

Inclusion & Diversity

At Perfect Vision, we believe in equal opportunity and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We warmly welcome and encourage applications from individuals with special needs (motor disabilities), as we provide fully equipped facilities and a friendly workspace designed to ensure they can perform their duties with the highest levels of comfort and professionalism.

Apply Now!

jobs.title: Senior PHP Backend Developer (Riyadh, KSA)
jobs.why: Requires 3+ years in PHP development, which is outside candidate's primary Python/TypeScript stack.

jd.text:
FileCloud is looking for an enthusiastic Senior PHP Backend Developer to join our team in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. As part of the Growth & Expansion team, you will be responsible for developing server-side functionality and building scalable cloud-based services. We are looking for a mid-level or senior developer.  This role is fully office-based and will require working in our office in Riyadh and connecting with the wider, global FileCloud team

About the Product & Company:

FileCloud is a hyper-secure EFSS (enterprise file sync and share) platform that provides industry leading compliance, data governance, data leak protection, data retention and digital rights management capabilities. FileCloud is a leader in content governance and collaboration for unstructured data, trusted and used worldwide across Global 1000 enterprises, educational institutions, government organizations, and service providers. In addition to its enterprise file sharing solution, FileCloud’s product portfolio also includes Signority (acquired in May 2024), a Canadian-based e-signature and document workflow platform. We are currently expanding our team as we grow and improve FileCloud.

Responsibilities:

• Create elegant, efficient and bulletproof software to support and extend our current software products
• Use tools including PHPStorm, MongoDB, NodeJS, AWS/AZURE, GIT, Memcache, Code Reviews, PHPUnit, Solr, among others
• Solve complex architectural challenges when implementing new features
• Integrate with databases, file systems, cloud services when delivering solutions
• Troubleshoot and fix reported customer issues, delivering software patches as needed
• Share your knowledge and experience with other engineers

Qualifications:

• 4+ years of professional software engineering experience
• 3+ years of experience in web app development
• 3+ years in PHP development
• Strong knowledge of the following:
• Automation testing
• Client server architecture is required
• Object-oriented programming and design patterns
• PHP ecosystems (PHP 8.2+ experience, Composer, PHPUnit)
• Web technologies including HTTP protocol, XML, REST
• Highly proficient in spoken and written English with strong communication skills
• Comfortable using AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as part of a daily development workflow - for code generation, review, debugging, and documentation.

Nice-to-Have:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline
• Knowledge of modern PHP frameworks
• Experience in enterprise system’s architecture (Architecture Patterns, Eventing, Queues)
• Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases like MongoDB and their declarative query languages
• Basic understanding of front-end technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3
• Knowledge of CI/CD (Jenkins preferred), Docker, SOLR, Redis
• Experience developing with NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript.

What We Offer – These Do Not Change

• Be part of a team of passionate, committed individuals dedicated to building a world-class product
• Dedicated time for training and education opportunities
• A mentorship model wherein your mentor and team support your development
• A competitive salary with an annual bonus
• Onsite work with flexible hours that fall outside of 9am -12pm (US Eastern Standard Time)
• 20 days of paid time off, which increases by a further 2 days after 3 years of service and 3 days after 5 years of service (in addition to 10 public holidays in your country)
• Paid day off on your birthday or on an alternative day if your birthday falls outside a typical working day
• Paid day off to volunteer with the charity of your choice
• Paid monthly internet cost, as well as lunch and a wellbeing stipend provided
• Reimbursement of all hardware costs associated with the role

Please note that we conduct background security checks for everyone joining our team.

AI-assisted screening may be used during the application review process.
